question: Should the dashboard agent-status widget land now as a `sessions.list`-backed builtin through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826, or should this wait for the broader Gateway activity contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127?
rationale: The requested UI is coherent, but maintainers need to choose whether coarse session-list status is acceptable for this dashboard slice or whether current task/progress/attention semantics must wait for a canonical Gateway API.

options.title: Review the staged dashboard builtin
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate UI solution while requiring its merge blockers and proof to clear before this issue closes.

options.title: Wait for the Gateway activity contract
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 settles the durable activity, progress, attention, and child-session semantics.

options.title: Fold into the roadmap tracker
options.body: Move the unique widget requirements into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 and use that roadmap item to own sequencing.

recommendation.title: Review the staged dashboard builtin
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate UI solution while requiring its merge blockers and proof to clear before this issue closes.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision primarily affects Control UI/plugin-tab product direction, while Gateway semantics can route to vincentkoc if maintainers choose the activity-contract path.
